name: Copilots for everyone

persona.organisation: A Zimbabwean professional services firm with 250 staff
persona.temperament: Enthusiastic about AI; open to evidence

hiddenFacts.fact: Document drafting is the main use case; nobody has measured benefits yet.
Our data permissions need cleaning up before a rollout.

goal: Budget a measured pilot instead of an unsupported full rollout
opening: I'm the CIO. The board wants AI copilots for all 250 staff next year.
script: Challenge the hype and propose a small pilot with success measures.
Include training and a data-readiness assessment.

expectations.description: Recommends a bounded pilot with adoption, quality and benefit measures
Highlights data permissions and governance prerequisites
Defers a blanket rollout pending evidence and includes training costs
